resources.string: No place in the index is called \"%1$s\".
No connection, so these are the places kept or seen on this device. A name two places share within one region is not among them.
Place names need a connection. A code, coordinates or a link still work.
Fewer characters name the area around this place: a market, a block, a delivery zone. Every code inside an area begins with it.
About %1$s north to south and %2$s east to west.
Every code that begins %1$s lies inside it. Ten characters name a doorway; fewer name the area around it.
Show where I am, for an emergency
In an emergency, call your local emergency number. Read them the latitude and longitude: anyone can use those.
Accurate to within about %1$d m, inside a single cell.
The app is not allowed to use your location, so it cannot say where you are.
Location is switched off on this device. Switch it on and the card will show where you are.
%1$s names an area about %2$s across, so this code is its centre, not a door.
The link gives its coordinates to about %1$s, so this code is no closer than that.
The link gives the centre of the map as it was shared, not a place anybody pinned.
That is a what3words address. Only its owner\'s service can turn one into a place, and this app uses nobody\'s service. Ask for the coordinates or a code instead.
That is a short Google Maps link, which says where it goes only when it is opened. Open it in a browser and paste the full address it becomes.
No place called %2$s was found to read the Plus Code %1$s against.
Reading the Plus Code %1$s needs a connection to find %2$s.
Nothing saved yet. The bookmark on a place\'s card keeps it here, with its directions.
Cell %1$s m north to south, %2$s m east to west
Your device placed you to within about %1$d m, which is inside a single cell.
Your device placed you to within about %1$d m. The code is exact for the point it was given, and at this accuracy that point may not be your doorway.

Five characters name a position inside a cell 8 by 10.7 km, so they need a reference near the point to be read back. These are the places near enough that recovery is guaranteed. A reference further off does not fail; it returns somewhere else.
No landmark is near enough to anchor a short form here. Share the full ten characters instead: they resolve on their own.
The landmarks could not be reached. The full code needs no reference.
Exact places share this point\'s level-5 cell, so a reader who goes by that cell rather than by the place\'s coordinates recovers the code exactly.
Part of the area around this point could not be read, the edge of an area kept offline or a shard that did not arrive, so places there are missing from this list.
The area around here, about %1$d by %2$d km, is a few hundred kilobytes at most. Kept, its landmarks work without a connection.
The map itself is not downloaded: it draws offline wherever it has already been looked at.
This area is kept offline, and holds no landmarks.
That area could not be kept. With a connection, try again.
Everything kept has been given back.

The grid does not wrap at the poles, so there is no pad here.

The code is the same in every language; only the words that spell it change. Choose the words the person listening already knows.
This device has no %1$s voice. Read the words out yourself, or add the voice to the device\'s speech engine.
That is not a code, a pair of coordinates or a link this app can read.
That is not a code this app can read (%1$s).
%1$s is from the reserved range. It is well formed, and it does not name a place.
Hold still. The fix is getting tighter.
The app is not allowed to use your location. A code can still be typed, pasted or picked on the map.
Location is switched off on this device. A code can still be typed, pasted or picked on the map.
No fix arrived. Outdoors or by a window, one usually comes within a minute.
No place called %2$s was found, so %1$s cannot be read against it. The full ten characters need no reference.
More than one place answers to %2$s. With its region, as in the line this app shares, %1$s can be read against the right one.
%2$s shares its name with another place in the same region, so %1$s could be read against the wrong one. Ask for the full ten characters.
Reading %1$s needs a connection to look up %2$s. The full ten characters need no reference.
%1$s is shaped like a short form, but uses symbols no code contains.
